mapper.select:
select config_key, config_value, config_type, config_comment, config_sort, op_type, op_value, config_enable, terminal_type, create_by, create_date, update_by, update_date from ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_sys_configs where 1=1 and 1 = 1
and config_type = #{param.configType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or config_type = ''
and config_key = #{param.configKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
order by config_sort
